families.label: Workspace
families.description: Conversation workspaces with typed screen presets for chat, tabbed agents, multiple agents, a starter screen and image generation.
families.configuration: Choose a preset for the screen composition. Pass its typed data and callbacks as props; use child components for visual variants such as tabVariant or selectionVariant.

families.label: Dashboard
families.description: Overview, finance and marketing layouts composed from shared metrics, typed charts and collection controls.
families.configuration: Choose a preset for the dashboard composition. Supply the matching metrics and collections through typed props. Each chart retains its own data model.

families.label: Profile
families.description: Account and medical profile layouts with shared identity and navigation, while retaining their separate domain data.
families.configuration: Choose account or medical, then supply that preset’s profile schema. Medical details and account usage keep separate typed fields.

families.label: Composer
families.description: One composer family: the base input, a model and permission panel, attachments and an animated loading edge.
families.configuration: Configure Composer with model, attachments, isWorking and slots. ComposerPanel composes provider and permission controls; ComposerLoader decorates the input with an animated edge. These compositions use their own exported components.

families.label: Button
families.description: Related action controls in one family: text buttons, icon actions, navigation links and provider sign-in buttons.
families.configuration: Use variant for visual emphasis, size for geometry and props for loading or icons. Use LinkButton for navigation and SocialButton for provider identity; preserve their native semantics. ButtonGroup remains a separate composition.
